question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series

12.8, 13.5, 14.9, 17, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :** Consecutive multiples of (7) are added subsequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/349487d58efa77106154e3a0de3ad415bb7297a8d00ec5dbb1d60cb8635d26d7.png] 

Hence, **"19.8"** is the correct answer.
